facts.fact: Under the PARAE e-government loan, the AfDB finances an artificial intelligence hub and will equip Cote d'Ivoire with AI digital infrastructure, including high-performance computing and GPUs, per AfDB deputy director for West Africa Joseph Ribero.

systems.system: Projet d'appui au renforcement de l'administration electronique (PARAE)
